svg.text: A leads down to Level 2: lantern gate, 2 arched stone bridges, ladder shaft,
open archway. Graffiti on the stones.
Crypt of the Faithful: 3 sarcophagi, candles, funerary urns,
Gauntlet: 2 spiked pit traps, pressure plate, scattered bones,
Strongroom: chest, 2 coin heaps, pressure plate, wall
Shrine: altar, 2 braziers, statue, pillar, banners, wall
Ossuary: skull heap, scattered bones, skeletons, burial
A comes up from Level 1, through an open archway.
B leads down to Level 3: stone arch, rickety rope bridge, ladder shaft, arched
stone bridge, portcullis. Bats lurk along the way. Graffiti on the stones.
Glimmering Cave: glowing crystals, giant mushrooms,
Bone Gallery: skull heap, scattered bones, skeletons.
B comes up from Level 2, through a portcullis.

text.textPath: The Tomb of the Sleeping Prince

svg.text: A roofless chapel above, a crypt below, and something older beneath the bones
Each level is a cutaway slice of earth; front walls removed. One flagstone is about 5 ft. Lettered diamonds mark where the ways between levels begin and end.
